title: A backend that was never written
author: Diego Pacheco
body:
Every endpoint this app talks to is served by Mockoon.

The interesting part is that the mock keeps state. Create a book in one request and the next list call returns it, the same way LocalStack answers for AWS.

No database, no server code, one JSON environment file.

title: Specs first, mock second, UI last
author: Diego Pacheco
body:
The OpenAPI files under spec/ are the source of truth.

The generator hands them to Mockoon, upgrades the imported routes into stateful CRUD routes, and the React app is written against the same contract.

Change the spec, regenerate, and the mock follows.
